profiles.sourceBoundary: The runtime consumes an admitted passive Surface shape with an Initiative Proficiency Bonus roll modifier and an immediate Initiative Swap atom. Character Battle derives the final Initiative score from the caller-supplied Initiative roll total, existing CharacterBuild level progression, and retained support profile when the player chooses to add the Proficiency Bonus. Battle runtime owns only the start-battle setup swap boundary: callers enter the setup workflow from BattleCreatureInit input, not from an arbitrary BattleState, so consumed source opportunities cannot be reset by re-entering setup after a swap. During setup, both combatants must be present in the same combat, on the same side, distinct, the ally must be willing, no combatant may have acted yet, neither participant may be Incapacitated, the source must not have consumed its one post-roll swap opportunity, and the existing Initiative scores are swapped and re-ordered without dispatching on Alert identity or storing parallel swap state in BattleState.

Battle damage adjustment consumes the admitted character Unit support profile directly from characterUnitRefs without storing a separate resistance-only damage type field.

profiles.sourceBoundary: Character creation preserves one selected CharacterBuild Draconic Ancestry fact from the species-owned source table. Battle Unit admission derives that selected damage type from the CharacterBuild ancestry selection and selected species Surface source table together with the authored Breath Weapon Surface activation shape: replace one Attack-action attack, self-origin Cone or Line choice, Dexterity innate save DC from Constitution, character-level d10 damage tiers, half damage on success, Proficiency Bonus use cap, and Long Rest reset. Character battle initialization derives battle resources from retained build Unit refs so species traits with supported use-count mechanics are admitted without a parallel species-resource list. Runtime derives the executable Breath Weapon profile from the selected Unit support profile plus the resource Unit at discovery and resolution time, spends one use, replaces one Attack-action attack through the shared action-resource protocol, consumes table-supplied area membership and Saving Throw outcomes, validates the damage dice tier, and applies the selected Draconic Ancestry damage without dispatching on authored species or trait identity.

profiles.sourceBoundary: Runtime consumes typed table-supplied object identity facts, emitter-distance facts, and opaque-cover witnesses. Continual Flame consumes a touched-object fact, owns level-2+ Spell Slot casting, source-owned object attachment, Bright/Dim 20-foot radii, non-ticking until-dispelled persistence, and preserves prior Continual Flame emitters from the same caster. Existing light projection derives Bright/Dim/Darkness to sight-obscurement and Darkvision-adjusted sight consequences without duplicating emitter state. Removal or suppression triggers such as Dispel Magic, Darkness overlap, and Antimagic Field are owned outside this object-emitter profile; this profile exposes object attachment and the until-dispelled marker for those removal or suppression owners, while any additional generic Spell Effect facts belong to the remover or suppressor owner rather than a Continual Flame-specific registry. Colored/flame presentation, automatic line-of-sight drawing, automatic map geometry/pathfinding derivation, non-heat/fuel presentation, smother/quenched adjudication, and costly consumed Material component availability/consumption are outside this object-emitter runtime boundary.

profiles.sourceBoundary: This profile supports Command Drop by consuming canonical character loadout held-object facts when present or caller-supplied held-object facts otherwise, emitting dropped-object outcomes, and ending the target turn. It does not add general inventory simulation, object placement, or loadout mutation.
profiles.title: Spell invocation resolves Command Drop through held-object facts and dropped-object outcomes

profiles.sourceBoundary: This profile supports Command Approach by consuming caller-supplied route/proximity facts on the existing Movement fill when movement is available, spending the target's movement through the normal movement reducer, and ending the target turn only when that supplied route reaches within 5 feet of the caster. If the target has no available movement, it clears the pending Approach effect without ending the turn. It does not add pathfinding or route storage.
profiles.title: Spell invocation resolves Command Approach through caller-supplied shortest-direct-route movement facts

profiles.sourceBoundary: This profile supports Command Flee by consuming caller-supplied fastest-available moving-away route facts on the existing Movement fill, requiring the selected remaining Movement budget to be spent when movement is available, clearing the pending effect, and ending the target turn. If the target has no available movement, it clears the pending Flee effect and ends the turn without a Movement fill. Opportunity Attack eligibility is derived from the Movement fill's actual provoked-threat facts, not from Command route metadata. It does not add pathfinding, route storage, or route-choice policy.
profiles.title: Spell invocation resolves Command Flee through caller-supplied fastest-available moving-away route facts

profiles.title: Unit feature applies Extended Spell cast-local duration extension and Concentration save Advantage to promoted duration witnesses

profiles.sourceBoundary: The runtime consumes selected Subtle Spell Metamagic effectKind and Sorcery Point cost facts from the character's known Metamagic options, the existing Font of Magic Sorcery Point point-pool, and canonical Surface spell component requirements. It derives a cast-local component projection for action-time spell casts, suppresses Verbal and Somatic components, suppresses only focus-replaceable Material components, preserves consumed or priced Material component requirements, rejects non-action-time spell casts and spells with no component requirements before resource spending, and leaves stealth, audibility, visibility, Counterspell, hidden-caster, free-hand, Silence, and future procedure-specific component consumers outside this profile subset.
profiles.title: Unit feature applies Subtle Spell cast-local component suppression projection

profiles.sourceBoundary: Character Sheet consumes an installed Surface Spell Definition shape with caller-selected creature recipients, slot-scaled Hit Point healing, a granted Short Rest benefit, and a same-spell recipient lockout reset by the recipient finishing a Long Rest. The runtime spends one Spell Slot at completion, applies existing Short Rest benefit logic per selected Character Sheet without duplicating rest algorithms, applies capped spell healing from caller-supplied dice, stores only the same-spell recipient lockout source reference in Long Rest-cleared sheet rest state, and leaves completed 10-minute casting, range maintenance, and interruption tracking to caller/table facts.
profiles.title: Character Sheet applies a spell-granted Short Rest benefit with slot-scaled healing and Long Rest recipient lockout

profiles.sourceBoundary: The runtime consumes the authored Antimagic Field ongoing-spell suppression shape, a self-origin 10-foot Emanation area identity, and caller-supplied affected tracked ongoing Spell Effect facts. It owns Magic Action and level-8-or-higher Spell Slot spending, caster-owned Concentration up to 1 hour, active Antimagic Field suppression state, suppression of ordinary tracked spell-created light emitters and tracked spellObjectContactDamage and Spiritual Weapon active-effect occurrences without deleting the ongoing spell occurrence, duration ticking while suppressed, exclusion of artifact/deity spell sources from suppression, and cleanup on Concentration or duration end. The remaining Antimagic Field clauses are intentionally split by owner outside this tracked-effect subset: aura-membership action interdiction, magical-effect targeting/delivery interdiction, magic-item property suppression, table-spatial magical area clipping, planar travel blocking, portal closure, Dispel Magic immunity on the aura, and broader not-yet-tracked ongoing Spell Effect suppression.
profiles.title: Spell invocation suppresses tracked ongoing spell effects inside Antimagic Field

profiles.sourceBoundary: The runtime consumes the active Antimagic Field aura identity created by the existing ongoing-spell suppression profile plus caller-supplied aura-membership witnesses keyed by area and source combatant. It owns explicit Emanation origin-inclusion membership, Action spell discovery suppression, Bonus Action spell discovery suppression, triggered Reaction spell discovery suppression, stale spell subject rejection, and supported non-spell Magic Action feature discovery and stale-subject rejection for creatures inside an active aura. Table geometry, automatic aura membership derivation, magical-effect targeting or delivery blocking, magic-item property suppression, table-spatial area clipping, represented teleport destination transit blocking, planar travel blocking, portal closure, Dispel Magic immunity, and broader ongoing Spell Effect suppression remain outside this owner.
profiles.title: Spell invocation blocks spellcasting and Magic actions inside Antimagic Field aura membership witnesses

profiles.sourceBoundary: The runtime consumes the active Antimagic Field aura identity and caller-supplied aura-membership witnesses created by the existing Antimagic Field suppression/action-interdiction owners. It owns a generic magical-effect source classification for spells, future magic items, and other magical effects, and uses that shared boundary to reject selected spell targets, table-supplied spell area affected creatures, object-contact spell affected creatures, and supported non-spell Magic Action feature targets that are inside an active aura. It does not derive table geometry, duplicate spell-specific target state, dispatch on authored spell, feature, or item identity, suppress magic-item properties, clip represented area geometry, close portals, model planar travel, model Dispel Magic immunity, or broaden ongoing Spell Effect suppression.
profiles.title: Spell invocation blocks magical effects from targeting or affecting things inside Antimagic Field aura membership witnesses

profiles.sourceBoundary: The runtime consumes a caller-supplied point-origin 20-foot-radius Sphere area identity, caster-owned Concentration up to 10 minutes, active Difficult Terrain movement-cost facts derived from caller-supplied movement distance through the area, and 2d4 Piercing damage per 5 feet traveled into or within the area. It owns Magic Action and level-2-or-higher Spell Slot spending, the active hazard identity, movement-cost projection, movement-triggered damage scaling, and cleanup on Concentration or duration end. Automatic geometry and pathfinding remain table/spatial facts. Camouflaged-terrain recognition is an accepted runtime-detached Search/perception witness: the table owns visibility at cast time, the Search Action declaration before entry, skill/check result, and recognized-hazard witness; runtime does not store per-observer terrain knowledge.
profiles.title: Spell invocation creates a Spike Growth area hazard with movement-metered piercing damage

profiles.sourceBoundary: The runtime consumes the authored See Invisibility spell and owns Magic Action and Spell Slot spend, the one-hour self effect, observer-scoped creature visibility over the Invisible condition, and duration cleanup. Object visibility and Ethereal visibility remain caller-witnessed observer facts rather than stored geometry, plane, cover, or duplicated condition state.
profiles.title: Spell invocation applies a timed self observer-sight effect that reveals Invisible creatures and caller-witnessed Invisible or Ethereal targets without mutating target state
Spell save gate applies Ray of Enfeeblement D20 Test lifecycle effects

profiles.sourceBoundary: The runtime consumes Ray of Enfeeblement's failed-save active effect as one source-side 1d8 damage-roll penalty owned by the affected target. It requests a typed rolled-dice hole keyed to each positive source damage-roll hole, subtracts the roll from by-type damage before target-side Resistance, spell damage reductions, Concentration saves, zero-Hit-Point disposition, and damage application, and removes the paired penalty with the Ray lifecycle effect through repeat-save success or Concentration cleanup without storing duplicate damage state.
profiles.title: Ray of Enfeeblement failed save subtracts 1d8 from source damage rolls

profiles.sourceBoundary: The runtime consumes the authored Dragon's Breath ongoing-effect Surface shape, caller-supplied one willing touched creature target facts, a caster-selected damage type from the authored damage-type hole, and a selected level-2-or-higher Spell Slot. It owns Bonus Action and Spell Slot spending, caster-owned Concentration up to 1 minute, target-attached active effect replacement for the same caster and spell, chosen damage type retention, original slot level retention, caster Spell Save DC retention at cast time, and cleanup when the caster's Concentration ends. The target-granted Magic action, 15-foot Cone placement, affected-creature area membership, Dexterity save-for-half damage, and slot-scaled breath damage execution remain outside this profile and are owned by L12G-FOLLOWUP-DRAGONS-BREATH-GRANTED-ACTION.
profiles.title: Spell invocation stores Dragon's Breath target-attached breath effect state

profiles.sourceBoundary: The runtime consumes the target-attached Dragon's Breath effect created by the initial cast, caller/table 15-foot Cone area membership facts, Dexterity Saving Throw outcomes, and a slot-scaled damage roll. It owns target-side Magic action discovery and spending, retained damage type and original slot-level damage dice, retained caster Spell Save DC for the Dexterity save, failed-save full damage, successful-save half damage, and shared damage lifecycle integration for Concentration and zero-Hit-Point follow-up holes. Automatic Cone geometry and affected-creature derivation remain table/caller facts at the fill boundary.
profiles.title: Spell invocation grants Dragon's Breath target Magic action with Cone save-for-half damage

profiles.sourceBoundary: Character Creation retains selected subclass feature grants in CharacterBuild feature refs from the selected subclass and class level. Character Sheet consumes those retained feature refs, installed Surface passive grant_spell_access facts, and installed Surface grant_class_level_prepared_spell_access tier facts to derive prepared spell access from the existing build class level, including duplicate-selection rejection for Book of Shadows, without storing a parallel prepared-spell list. Individual Spell Definition legality, spell-list membership, and invocation behavior remain owned by spell profiles.
profiles.title: Character Sheet derives prepared Spell Access from retained class-feature grants

profiles.sourceBoundary: Character Sheet consumes the retained Circle of the Land feature ref from CharacterBuild, the installed Surface Long Rest land-choice spell table, current selected land sheet state, and the Druid spellcasting source and class level. It requires explicit selected-land state, changes that state only through Long Rest choice input, derives prepared Spell Access without storing the resulting spell list, and leaves individual Spell Definition invocation support to spell profiles.
profiles.title: Character Sheet derives Circle of the Land prepared Spell Access from selected land state

profiles.sourceBoundary: The runtime consumes the authored Spiritual Weapon ongoing-effect shape plus caller-supplied force placement, force movement, and target-within-force-reach facts. It owns Bonus Action and level-2-or-higher Spell Slot spending, caster-owned Concentration up to 1 minute, a spell-owned attack proxy active effect, immediate and later melee Spell Attacks, slot-scaled Force damage, later-turn Bonus Action movement up to 20 feet, and cleanup on Concentration or duration end. Automatic map geometry, pathfinding, force-space derivation, and target adjacency derivation remain caller/table spatial facts.
profiles.title: Spell invocation creates and moves a Spiritual Weapon attack proxy with table-supplied force witnesses

profiles.sourceBoundary: Character Sheet consumes CharacterBuild class progression, installed Surface class-feature grants, a caller-supplied skill Ability Check witness, and caller-supplied active feature witnesses. It derives optional substitutions available for that check while preserving the default Ability and without storing duplicate skill proficiency or active-feature state.
profiles.title: Character Sheet projects skill-scoped optional Ability Check ability substitutions from retained class features

profiles.sourceBoundary: Character Sheet consumes CharacterBuild class progression, selected subclass feature grants, and installed Surface class-feature jump-distance substitution grants to derive optional jump-distance Ability substitutions from source facts rather than storing a parallel movement rule.
profiles.title: Character Sheet projects optional jump-distance ability substitutions from retained class features

profiles.sourceBoundary: Character Sheet consumes retained class-feature grant_speed facts, including selected subclass feature grants, and preserves linked-speed projections such as Climb Speed equal to Speed as a link to the walk Speed source, not as a copied numeric Speed.
profiles.title: Character Sheet projects linked special Speeds from retained class features

profiles.sourceBoundary: Character Creation consumes CharacterBuild class progression, installed Surface class-feature modify_max_hp grants, and class-level scaling facts to derive durable Hit Point maximum bonuses without storing a second HP progression table.
profiles.title: Character Creation derives Hit Point maximum bonuses from retained class features

profiles.sourceBoundary: Battle Unit admission consumes the authored Surface spell_slot_healing_modifier shape for spells the caster casts with a Spell Slot that restore Hit Points on that turn. Battle initialization retains the parsed support profile on the character combatant, and direct Hit Point restoration consumes the existing spell-slot invocation level and healing target facts to add 2 plus the spent Spell Slot level to each healed creature without authored-identity dispatch, duplicate Spell Slot state, or effects on non-slot/non-spell/unsupported healing procedures.
profiles.title: Unit feature adds a Spell Slot healing bonus equal to 2 plus the slot level

profiles.sourceBoundary: Battle Unit admission consumes the authored Surface magic_action_healing_pool shape, a referenced Channel Divinity resource Unit, 30-foot point range, Bloodied creature targeting including self, class-level multiplier pool, and half-Hit-Point-maximum per-target cap. Battle runtime retains the selected profile on character combatants, spends the Magic Action and existing Channel Divinity resource, consumes caller-supplied target distribution and range facts, applies healing, and rejects missing-resource, missing-action, non-Bloodied, out-of-range, over-pool, and over-cap fills without authored-identity dispatch or duplicate resource state.
profiles.title: Unit feature projects a Magic Action resource-spent healing pool with Bloodied target caps

profiles.sourceBoundary: Battle Unit admission consumes the authored Surface magic_action_area_save_damage_healing shape, a referenced Wild Shape resource Unit, a point within 60 feet, a 10-foot-radius Sphere, Constitution save against class spell save DC, Necrotic damage with half damage on success, one healing target in the area, and the SRD Druid-level damage/healing dice thresholds. Battle runtime retains the selected profile, derives 2d6, 3d6, or 4d6 damage and healing from the existing Druid class level, spends the Magic Action and existing Wild Shape resource, consumes caller-supplied area membership, Saving Throw, damage-roll, and healing-roll facts, applies Necrotic damage with half damage on success, heals one in-area creature, and rejects missing-resource, invalid-area, invalid-save-fill, invalid-healing-target, malformed-roll, and inconsistent scaling-fill cases without duplicating Wild Shape state or geometry.
profiles.title: Unit feature projects a Magic Action area Constitution save damage plus one-target healing profile

profiles.sourceBoundary: Battle Unit admission consumes the authored Surface enemy_zero_hit_point_temporary_hit_points trigger and Charisma-modifier-plus-class-level amount with minimum 1. Battle runtime retains the admitted support profile on character combatants, consumes existing damage-source and side-based beneficiary-target enemy relationship facts plus caller-supplied 10-foot beneficiary range facts, and applies ordinary non-stacking Temporary Hit Point replacement when a qualifying enemy is reduced to 0 Hit Points without requiring the damage source to be an enemy of the defeated creature or dispatching on authored feature identity.
profiles.title: Unit feature grants Temporary Hit Points when an enemy is reduced to 0 Hit Points nearby

profiles.sourceBoundary: Battle Unit admission consumes the authored Surface bonus_action_delegated_standard_actions shape and preserves its Bonus Action cost as delegated permission metadata. This profile does not claim an independent battle reducer or QNT shell: current battle runtime has no concrete lock, trap, pocket, generic Utilize, or magic-item activation BattleSubject that Fast Hands can wrap without inventing item or object state. The concrete delegated owners must spend the Bonus Action when they consume this profile.
profiles.title: Unit feature admits delegated Bonus Action standard-action permissions

profiles.sourceBoundary: Battle Unit admission consumes the authored Surface remarkable_athlete shape and projects typed Initiative Advantage, Strength (Athletics) Advantage, and immediate post-Critical Hit half-Speed movement facts without dispatching on feature id. Battle initiative, ability-check, attack-critical, movement, and Opportunity Attack execution must consume these facts in the existing runtime owners before this profile can claim promoted reducer/QNT parity.
profiles.title: Unit feature admits Remarkable Athlete roll and critical-hit movement facts

profiles.sourceBoundary: Battle Unit admission consumes the authored Surface open_hand_technique shape referencing the Monk Focus Flurry of Blows option and projects typed Addle, Push, and Topple rider facts without duplicating Monk Focus resource state or dispatching on subclass identity. Battle runtime consumes the retained profile from supported Flurry of Blows hit windows, applies Addle Opportunity Attack denial, gates Push and Topple behind the required failed Saving Throws, validates Push distance/disposition facts, treats successful saves as no-ops, and rejects stale, non-Flurry, unsupported-disposition, and missing-profile cases through the existing Monk Focus, attack, Saving Throw, forced-movement, and condition owners.
profiles.title: Unit feature admits Open Hand Technique Flurry of Blows rider choices

profiles.sourceBoundary: Battle Unit admission consumes the authored Surface sacred_weapon shape and referenced Paladin Channel Divinity resource and projects typed action, resource-spend, held-melee-weapon, Charisma attack-roll bonus, normal-or-Radiant damage choice, light facts, and dismissal facts without duplicating item or resource state. Battle initialization retains the selected Sacred Weapon support profile on character combatants. Battle resource projection admits only the Paladin Channel Divinity use-count resource required by this Sacred Weapon spend path, not every Channel Divinity-shaped resource container. Battle action discovery and resolution consume existing action economy state, existing Paladin Channel Divinity resource state, and existing selected loadout/weapon attack facts to offer Sacred Weapon only for an available Attack action, an available use, and a held Melee weapon; activation spends the Attack action and one use, records a single active binding to the selected weapon item, rejects stale missing-resource or Ranged-weapon subjects, and replaces the previous binding on recast. The active binding is then consumed by attack, damage-type, light-projection, no-action dismissal, timed-expiration, and no-longer-carried cleanup owners, deriving all executable facts from the support profile, existing character statistics, selected loadout weapon state, and active-effect lifecycle.
profiles.title: Unit feature activates Sacred Weapon and applies the bound weapon attack, damage, light, and lifecycle effects

profiles.sourceBoundary: Battle Unit admission consumes the authored Surface hunters_prey choose-one shape and projects typed Colossus Slayer and Horde Breaker option facts without storing a parallel weapon or target model. Character finalization records the selected option on the selected Unit ref, character-to-battle handoff preserves that typed option in BattleUnitRef, and battle runtime consumes existing weapon-hit, target Hit Point, once-per-turn, same-weapon, damage-rider, and caller-supplied target-predicate facts to resolve optional Colossus Slayer and Horde Breaker while rejecting missing selection, same target, invalid predicate, and repeated-use cases without authored-identity dispatch.
profiles.title: Unit feature admits Hunter's Prey Colossus Slayer and Horde Breaker choice facts

profiles.sourceBoundary: Battle Unit admission consumes the authored Surface steady_aim shape and projects typed Bonus Action, no-prior-movement, next-attack-roll Advantage, and Speed-zero-until-end-of-turn facts. Battle runtime consumes the profile through existing movementSpentFeet, current Bonus Action, nextAttackRollBySelf active-effect, Speed projection, and turn-end cleanup state without duplicating movement history, action economy state, or Speed state.
profiles.title: Unit feature spends a Bonus Action to gain next-attack Advantage and Speed 0

profiles.sourceBoundary: Battle Unit admission consumes the authored Surface potent_cantrip shape and projects typed damaging-cantrip creature-target half-damage facts for attack misses and successful target saves while excluding additional effects and cantrip identity dispatch. Battle runtime retains the selected profile on character combatants and consumes it in existing spell attack, spell save, cantrip-damage, and additional-effect owners to apply half damage on supported creature-target cantrip misses or successful saves, suppress non-damage effects on those branches, and reject object-target or unsupported cantrip cases without authored cantrip identity dispatch.
profiles.title: Unit feature admits Potent Cantrip miss/save-success half-damage facts

profiles.sourceBoundary: The runtime consumes selected Seeking Spell Metamagic effectKind and Sorcery Point cost facts from the character's known Metamagic options, the existing Font of Magic Sorcery Point point-pool, and the pending single spell-attack-damage Attack Roll fill. A missed spell attack can reopen that same Attack Roll hole with a typed Seeking Spell reroll option; a reroll fill carries the original missed d20 and the forced replacement d20, spends 1 Sorcery Point only when the replacement is used, resolves hit, miss, natural-1 miss, and natural-20 critical from the replacement, and may combine with at most one different Metamagic option used for the same spell. Unknown options, unaffordable spends, original hits, generic miss-to-hit replacements, unsupported procedures, and repeated spell attack sequences are rejected before Sorcery Point spending without storing durable reroll opportunity state.
profiles.title: Unit feature applies Seeking Spell missed spell attack reroll

profiles.sourceBoundary: The runtime consumes selected Empowered Spell Metamagic effectKind and Sorcery Point cost facts from the character's known Metamagic options, the existing Font of Magic Sorcery Point point-pool, and the pending single spell-attack-damage rolledDice fill. A promoted Ray of Frost level-5 damage roll can carry a typed Empowered Spell reroll option; a reroll fill carries selected original damage dice and forced replacement dice, spends 1 Sorcery Point only when replacement dice are used, applies the replacement dice before damage totals, enforces the Charisma-modifier minimum-one selected-die limit, and may combine with at most one different Metamagic option used for the same spell. Unknown options, unaffordable spends, mismatched original dice, duplicate or non-existing dice positions, out-of-range replacement dice, over-limit selections, Scorching Ray repeated attack sequences, Magic Missile allocation, Saving Throw area damage, ongoing damage, object damage, and other non-promoted damage owners are rejected before Sorcery Point spending without storing durable reroll opportunity state.
profiles.title: Unit feature applies Empowered Spell damage dice reroll

profiles.sourceBoundary: The runtime consumes the authored Acid Arrow spell-attack Surface shape with fixed Acid initial damage, an explicit half-initial-only miss branch, and one fixed Acid end-of-next-turn later damage effect. It owns Magic Action and level-2-or-higher Spell Slot spending, ranged Spell Attack hit/miss adjudication, initial hit damage, miss-half-initial-only damage, hit-only target-end delayed damage storage, slot-scaled immediate and later damage dice, shared turn-boundary damage lifecycle holes, and cleanup of the one-shot delayed effect. Target visibility, cover, range path geometry, and spatial derivation remain caller/table facts.
profiles.title: Spell invocation resolves Acid Arrow immediate damage, miss-half damage, and target-end delayed damage
